newsitem.title: UK: US aide asks for sanctions action against Petronas.
newsitem.headline: US aide asks for sanctions action against Petronas.

text.p: The United States may consider taking action against Malaysia's state oil company Petronas after its involvement in Iran, Gregg Rickman, legislative director for senator Alfonso D'Amato said on Tuesday.

Rickman said that the sanctions committee had recommended action against Petronas in accordance with Iran/Libya sanctions bill signed earlier this year for its part in the Sirri oilfields exploration project, also involving France's Total.
"It's clear they (Petronas) should be sanctioned, we have written to the administration," he told the International Herald Tribune Oil and Money Conference.
He said Petronas' 30 percent stake in the $600 million project "places them over the limit," referring to the $40 million level above which investment contravenes the bill.
Rickman also said South Korean company Daewoo and others committed to investment in an Iranian petrochemical plant could also be subject to sanctions.
